svg.title: Downunder Voices Cartoon of the Day — Building the dream home, one brick at a time
svg.desc: Black-and-white pen-and-ink newspaper cartoon set on a new Western Australian housing estate. A house stands as a bare steel frame with only a few ragged courses of bricks at its base. A fictional bricklayer in a hard hat and hi-vis vest proudly holds a single sparkling brick aloft and tells a dismayed fictional couple holding their house plans, "Good news — the next brick arrives Tuesday!" Behind them a flatbed truck carries one brick chained down, and in the foreground five bricks sit on a pallet behind a velvet rope with a sign reading Rationed, please don't touch. Neighbouring finished brick homes, a Colorbond fence, a Norfolk pine and a gum tree fill the background.
svg.text: DOWNUNDER VOICES — CARTOON OF THE DAY
BUILDING THE DREAM HOME — ONE BRICK AT A TIME.
Source: ABC News, 16 November 2026 — WA builders are urged to look beyond bricks as a shortage drags on.
